note: Fits the profile criteria emphatically on starting point — 50, 12% body fat, climbing three or four nights a week, racing at expedition level, and explicitly wanting to go from good to better rather than be rescued ('there's nothing wrong right now'). He is self-employed as an event director and published an endurance-training book, which reads as successful if not a business owner or physician in the sense the ICP quote intends. He misses on income: $4,000 is 'a substantial portion of my annual income' and he has to check whether he can expense it through his business to afford it at all. He also misses on neglected health — health is the one area he has never neglected; it is his identity and his coping mechanism. What he actually needs is narrow technical instruction in one modality, which is a different purchase from the one the ICP describes.
